title: Validate QA bot prompt changes locally with GitHub MCP
summary: Unit tests do not catch LLM skill-switching regressions in azure-sdk-qa-bot-agent; replaying real PR queries against local `agents/chat_agent/init.py` with `GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token)` exercises live GitHub MCP and skill routing end-to-end.
solution: Load .env into the process environment, set GITHUB_TOKEN from `gh auth token` so GitHub MCP authenticates, start `agents/chat_agent/init.py` on port 8088, and POST the `[tenant_context]` + user message payload to `/responses` to inspect actual tool calls and output before deploying.
author: JiaqiZhang-Dev
